description: Fetch metadata for one World Bank indicator: name, description, unit, source dataset, source organization, and topics. Find IDs with worldbank_search_indicators.

indicator_id.description: One indicator ID (NY.GDP.PCAP.CD); not "all" or a list.

name: worldbank_get_indicator

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `indicator_not_found`: No indicator has this ID. `multiple_indicators`: The ID selects more than one indicator, as "all" does. `upstream_timeout`: The World Bank Indicators API did not answer within the call's 50-second budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

sourceNote.description: The source's description of the indicator.

sourceOrganization.description: Organization that collects or publishes the data.

title: Get World Bank Indicator
